_meta.name: The fabius benchmark
_meta.claim: One dated benchmark in four panels: on Panel A fabius improved three of four Claude tiers and reduced output on all four; Panel B's mixed, model-mediated historical receipt records model-graded factual-checklist gains while its reported executed-code scores tied at ceiling; Panel C recorded positive blind-judge demos across four external families; Panel D printed both gains and regressions. These measurements do not support a universal every-model claim.
receipt_limitations: Historical v5/v6/v7 score receipts do not contain candidate answer text, so the original generations cannot be independently re-judged from the repository.
Historical Panel B receipts do not contain generated execution artifacts or raw stdout/stderr; only bounded scores and short runner notes remain.
Panel C has aggregate numbers only; its raw portable receipt was not committed and an exact replay is impossible on moving model endpoints.
arms: terse (a generic 'be concise' control — the real test)
fabius (the shipped AGENTS.md + routed SKILL.md, verbatim)
_meta.honest_misses: Printed, not hidden: Panel B's mixed score rises on four models, entirely in its model-graded checklist track; historical model-operated executed-code score records tie. On Panel A three tiers gain, Haiku falls -0.33 overall (-1.03 vs terse), and pooled build/accessibility/game categories regress. Panel D includes core-tier and memory regressions.
_meta.models: Panel A/B generated on the four Claude models current at the 2026-07-01 run, each via per-agent model override: Fable 5 (claude-fable-5), Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8), Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5), Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5).
_meta.modes_panelD: Panel D executes the IDENTITY.md evaluation contract on the versioned Fabius Benchmark Suite (evals/suite/, FBS v1.0): BASE (bare model) / FAB (shipped AGENTS.md + routed SKILL.md verbatim) / FAB_MEMORY (FAB + the task's committed memory_snapshot as recalled fabius-archivum memory).

panelA_quality_newest_claude.method: 15 tasks x 3 arms on each of the four Claude models current at the 2026-07-01 run (Fable 5, Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Haiku 4.5); every answer scored /15 by TWO blind judges (opus+fable, averaged; inter-judge gap 0.72/15). The fabius arm loads the shipped files at run time — not a paraphrase.

panelB_mixed_verification.method: 9 deliverables x 3 arms x the same four models. Four code tasks were extracted, written, executed and reported by a tool-using Workflow agent against hidden tests; five domain deliverables were scored against fixed factual checklists by two model graders. This is a mixed model-mediated verification track, not a judge-free deterministic oracle. All executed-code arms tied at 100%; the measured lift comes from the model-graded checklist tasks.

panelC_external_demos.method: Blind cross-family demo on external providers via the portable harness (evals/portable_eval.py; 6 tasks, 3 categories, measured 2026-06-22 with live provider keys). Lift = fabius minus the 'be concise' control on genuine-build tasks, /15.
panelC_external_demos.note: Every measured family gained in the historical run. Gemini is wired in the harness (Google OpenAI-compatible endpoint), but no Gemini number was committed without a key. A new run creates a new dated measurement; it cannot reconstruct the missing historical raw receipt.

structural: node evals/structural.mjs — deterministic, no key; invariant count is derived at run time

panelD_fbs_run.method: 100 neutral production-shaped tasks (20 smoke / 50 core / 30 stress, categories A-J, toy problems banned, 3-6 fixed factual checks per task) x 3 modes; scored /28 on a 7-dimension 0-4 rubric by TWO blind judges (opus+fable; inter-judge gap 1.05/28 sonnet, 0.83/28 haiku) + one model grader interpreting the factual checks from answer text. Run 2026-07-05.
panelD_fbs_run.suite: evals/suite/ (FBS v1.0, committed; validator node evals/suite/validate.mjs = 9/9)
panelD_fbs_run.honest_notes: Core tier is the printed miss (FAB_MEMORY -0.60; FAB -0.48 of which most is one catastrophic 363-char stub answer on FAB-025 scoring 1.5/28 vs 28/28 for BASE and FAB_MEMORY; excluding it core FAB is 26.08 -> 26.13). Memory cuts both ways: design +4.91, security -1.57, error-recovery -1.37. A provider session-limit window interrupted some judge/grade calls; every generation completed and only missing judge/grade calls were re-issued with byte-identical prompts.
